# ArSee · Open-Source IEC 60870-5-101/103/104 Protocol Tester & Analyzer

Free Apache-2.0 Windows IEC 60870-5-101, IEC 60870-5-103 and IEC 60870-5-104 tester and evidence analyzer. Inspect original TX/RX frames, supported values/events, findings and native PDF reports. Not a production SCADA or certified IEC conformance suite.

## Published builds
- Latest public stable v3.6.10: https://github.com/masarray/ARIEC60870/releases/tag/v3.6.10
- Windows installer: https://github.com/masarray/ARIEC60870/releases/download/v3.6.10/ARIEC60870-v3.6.10-setup-win-x64.exe
- Windows portable ZIP: https://github.com/masarray/ARIEC60870/releases/download/v3.6.10/ARIEC60870-v3.6.10-win-x64.zip
- Previous stable v3.6.7: https://github.com/masarray/ARIEC60870/releases/tag/v3.6.7
- Integrated engine/UI Windows WPF/CI evidence: https://github.com/masarray/ARIEC60870/actions/runs/43157628091
- Unmerged SICAM IEC-101 serial changes in PR #145 are excluded and remain subject to physical FAT.

## Evidence boundary
An addressed link response is not always an accepted application ASDU. GI is not proof every point was received. HOLD pins only the displayed viewport, not recording. Unverified IEC-101 balanced mode or physical multi-vendor FAT must not be claimed.
